description: Prepare a coding-agent prompt from an owned report. One check uses one unit; full uses three. Three units are free once. Then US$0.10 per unit, or included in an active PageAudit plan. Read prompt_allowance first. Only send credit_token after explicit spending authorization; preserve request_id for retries. Use the assembled instructions instead of copying findings and building a prompt yourself. No model call is needed to generate it. Review placeholders and proposed changes before applying them. Verify the page after the fix.

check_id.description: ID from the report's checks; required for check, absent for full.

credit_token.description: Prepaid cred_… token. Requires explicit user authorization.

language.description: Language of the prompt instructions and check names: en for English, pt for Portuguese.

request_id.description: New UUID v4 per generation. Keep it unchanged for retries.
